service.name: prose-studio
service.description: Governed natural-language generation: a query plus a named writing style becomes a measured set of candidate outputs, converged to one committed document

ai-gateway.description: The only inference path. Every candidate is produced through typed inference on the write.default (quality lane) and write.diverse (candidate-set lane) roles. This scenario names no model, holds no vendor credential, and speaks no vendor protocol, which is also what makes its metering Class A without implementing metering here.
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: Generation refuses with a named error identifying the role. Styles, profiles, declarations, sessions, and every committed document stay fully readable. No direct-to-vendor fallback is ever attempted, and a partial candidate set is never presented as complete.

search-hub.description: Provider registration so styles and committed documents are reachable from federated query.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Federated reach is lost; local retrieval and every generation path are unaffected.

brand-manager.description: Resolves an optional brand reference carried on a style record. That reference is the entire coupling: this scenario owns prose voice and never visual identity. Disabled until a style actually carries one.
brand-manager.degraded_behavior: A style carrying an unresolved brand reference reports it unresolved; prose generation is unaffected.

content-desk.description: First intended declaring consumer, listed for documentation rather than for calling. The dependency direction is inverted: content-desk calls this scenario and declares its own profiles under its own .vrooli/prose-studio/ folder. This scenario hardcodes nothing about it.
content-desk.degraded_behavior: Not applicable; this scenario never calls content-desk.
